summary.zh: 用 InstancedMesh 一次绘制调用画出 3 万个方块，并和“一个物体一个网格”的做法对比绘制调用数。
summary.en: Draw 30,000 boxes in a single draw call with InstancedMesh, and compare draw calls against one mesh per object.

concepts.zh:
## 瓶颈常常不是三角形，而是绘制调用

每个普通 `Mesh` 渲染时，CPU 都要向 GPU 发出一次**绘制调用**（draw call）：切换着色器、上传矩阵和材质参数、提交命令。几千次调用之后，CPU 就成了瓶颈，哪怕每个物体只有 12 个三角形。

## InstancedMesh：一份几何体，画 N 次

如果许多物体共享**同一个几何体和同一个材质**，只是位置、旋转、缩放、颜色不同，就可以用 `InstancedMesh`：

```js
const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geometry, material, count);
dummy.position.set(x, y, z);
dummy.updateMatrix();
mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix);
mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
```

GPU 收到一次绘制调用，外加一个存放所有实例矩阵的缓冲区（`instanceMatrix`），着色器根据 `gl_InstanceID` 取出各自的矩阵。

## 每个实例的数据

- `setMatrixAt(i, matrix)`：写入第 i 个实例的变换。常见做法是用一个不加入场景的 `Object3D`（dummy）设置位置旋转缩放，再调用 `updateMatrix()` 取它的矩阵。
- `setColorAt(i, color)`：每个实例一种颜色，会和材质颜色相乘。
- 修改后要设置 `instanceMatrix.needsUpdate` / `instanceColor.needsUpdate`。每帧都改的话，用 `setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage)`。

## 读懂 renderer.info

`renderer.info.render.calls` 是上一次 `render()` 的绘制调用数，`triangles` 是三角形数。状态栏实时显示它们：instanced 模式下 calls 只有 1，而 separate meshes 模式下（上限 4000 个）calls 等于物体数量，CPU 时间明显更高——即使画的三角形更少。

## 注意事项

- 实例共享材质，不能各自用不同的材质类型或贴图（颜色、矩阵之外的差异需要自定义属性）。
- 视锥剔除以整个 InstancedMesh 为单位。实例在运动时包围球会过期，示例直接设置 `frustumCulled = false`；也可以调用 `computeBoundingSphere()`。
- 每帧在 JS 里更新几万个矩阵本身也有成本；真正海量的动画可以把运动挪到顶点着色器里计算。

> 把 count 拉到 100000，再切换两种模式，比较状态栏里的 CPU 毫秒数。
concepts.en:
## The bottleneck is often draw calls, not triangles

For every ordinary `Mesh`, the CPU issues a **draw call** to the GPU: bind a shader, upload matrices and material values, submit the command. After a few thousand of those the CPU becomes the bottleneck, even if each object is only 12 triangles.

## InstancedMesh: one geometry, drawn N times

When many objects share **the same geometry and the same material** and differ only in position, rotation, scale or colour, use `InstancedMesh`:

```js
const mesh = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geometry, material, count);
dummy.position.set(x, y, z);
dummy.updateMatrix();
mesh.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix);
mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
```

The GPU receives one draw call plus a buffer holding every instance matrix (`instanceMatrix`); the shader fetches its own matrix using `gl_InstanceID`.

## Per-instance data

- `setMatrixAt(i, matrix)`: writes instance i's transform. The usual pattern is an `Object3D` that is never added to the scene (the dummy): set its position, rotation and scale, call `updateMatrix()`, and copy its matrix.
- `setColorAt(i, color)`: one colour per instance, multiplied with the material colour.
- After changes, set `instanceMatrix.needsUpdate` / `instanceColor.needsUpdate`. If you change them every frame, use `setUsage(THREE.DynamicDrawUsage)`.

## Reading renderer.info

`renderer.info.render.calls` is the number of draw calls in the last `render()` and `triangles` the triangle count. The status line shows them live: in instanced mode calls is 1, while in separate-meshes mode (capped at 4,000) calls equals the object count and CPU time is clearly higher, even with fewer triangles.

## Caveats

- Instances share one material, so they cannot use different material types or textures (anything beyond matrix and colour needs custom attributes).
- Frustum culling works on the whole InstancedMesh. Moving instances make its bounding sphere stale, so the demo sets `frustumCulled = false`; calling `computeBoundingSphere()` is the alternative.
- Updating tens of thousands of matrices in JS every frame has its own cost; for truly massive animation, move the motion into the vertex shader.

> Push count to 100,000, switch between the two modes, and compare the CPU milliseconds in the status line.

zh: 把 BoxGeometry 换成 IcosahedronGeometry(1, 1)，观察三角形数量和帧率的变化。
把 count 设为 4000，比较两种模式下 draw calls 和 CPU 时间。
在循环里也调用 setColorAt，让颜色随波浪高度变化（记得设置 instanceColor.needsUpdate）。
删掉 instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true 这一行，看看画面会怎样。
en: Swap BoxGeometry for IcosahedronGeometry(1, 1) and watch the triangle count and frame rate.
Set count to 4000 and compare draw calls and CPU time in both modes.
Call setColorAt inside the loop so colour follows wave height (remember instanceColor.needsUpdate).
Delete the instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true line and see what happens.
